interventions.title: Clear Pedestrian Right-of-Way
interventions.description: Remove large trailers and portable toilets from the area intended for pedestrian travel to ensure a clear path.

interventions.title: Install Street Lighting
interventions.description: Add street lighting to the utility poles to improve visibility and safety for pedestrians during low-light conditions.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Planters
interventions.description: Adding street trees or small planters where space permits would provide a physical buffer between pedestrians and vehicles while improving the streetscape.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Lighting
interventions.description: Upgrading existing street lighting to pedestrian-scale LED fixtures would improve visibility and safety during evening hours.

interventions.title: Routine Maintenance
interventions.description: Regular cleaning of the sidewalk and trimming of vegetation to ensure the full width of the walkway is usable.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Lighting
interventions.description: Installation of lighting near the building gap to improve visibility and security for pedestrians at night.

interventions.title: Shared Street Design
interventions.description: Implement a shared street or 'woonerf' design with textured paving and no curbs to formalize the shared nature of the space and slow vehicles.

interventions.title: Clear Path Enforcement
interventions.description: Regulate building encroachments and construction site layouts to maintain a minimum clear walking width.

interventions.title: Improved Street Lighting
interventions.description: Add pedestrian-scale lighting to improve visibility and safety within the narrow corridor.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Clearance and Maintenance
interventions.description: Enforce regulations to keep sidewalks clear of construction materials and debris to maintain a continuous accessible path.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions or Planters
interventions.description: Install curb extensions or planters to create a buffer zone between pedestrians and vehicles, effectively narrowing the roadway and slowing traffic.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Add street lighting to improve visibility and safety for pedestrians during evening hours.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Repair and Leveling
interventions.description: Repave the sidewalk to provide a smooth, continuous, and ADA-compliant walking surface.

interventions.title: Street Lighting Improvements
interventions.description: Ensure pedestrian-scale lighting is adequate to improve visibility and safety at night.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Installation
interventions.description: Construct a formal, paved sidewalk with a curb to separate pedestrians from the informal parking area.

interventions.title: Street Lighting
interventions.description: Install pedestrian-scale street lighting to improve visibility and safety during evening hours.

interventions.title: Lot Frontage Improvement
interventions.description: Install fencing or landscaping to clearly define the edge of the lot and prevent vehicle encroachment onto the pedestrian path.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Widening and Repair
interventions.description: Reconstruct and widen the sidewalks to provide a continuous, ADA-compliant path that is safe for all users.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Implement curb extensions at intersections to improve sightlines and reduce the distance pedestrians must spend in the roadway.

interventions.title: Construct Raised Sidewalk
interventions.description: Install a standard raised sidewalk with a curb to provide physical separation and a dedicated space for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Clearance of Public Right-of-Way
interventions.description: Remove private property, construction materials, and debris from the street edge to ensure a clear path for travel.

interventions.title: Pavement Resurfacing
interventions.description: Repair and level the roadway and pedestrian surfaces to eliminate trip hazards and improve accessibility.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Clearance and Management
interventions.description: Implement designated areas for trash collection that do not obstruct the pedestrian clear path.

interventions.title: Shared Street (Woonerf) Treatment
interventions.description: Given the narrow width and residential nature, convert the street into a shared space with level surfaces and traffic calming to prioritize pedestrians.

interventions.title: Pavement Repair
interventions.description: Resurface the roadway to eliminate patches and uneven surfaces that can be tripping hazards or cause vehicle swerving.

interventions.title: Convex Safety Mirror
interventions.description: Install a convex mirror on the building corner to allow pedestrians and drivers to see around the blind spot.

interventions.title: Pavement Markings
interventions.description: Apply high-visibility paint or 'Watch for Pedestrians' markings at the mouth of the alley to alert drivers to the sidewalk crossing.

interventions.title: Improved Lighting
interventions.description: Install wall-mounted lighting at the alley entrance to improve visibility during evening and night hours.

interventions.title: Traffic Calming
interventions.description: Implement speed humps or cushions to ensure vehicle speeds remain very low on this narrow residential street.

interventions.title: Vegetation Maintenance
interventions.description: Prune overhanging trees and bushes to clear the full width of the sidewalk for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Widening
interventions.description: Widen the sidewalk to provide a consistent, accessible through-zone that accommodates building encroachments like steps.

interventions.title: Waste Management Policy
interventions.description: Implement or enforce regulations regarding the placement of trash for collection to ensure sidewalks remain clear of obstructions.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Expansion and Clearing
interventions.description: Ensure a minimum clear width for the existing sidewalk by managing household obstructions and potentially widening the path.

interventions.title: New Sidewalk Construction
interventions.description: Install a paved sidewalk on the right side of the street to provide a continuous and safe walking path for all users.

interventions.title: Vegetation Management
interventions.description: Pruning and clearing the overgrown vegetation to reclaim the full width of the existing sidewalk.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Widening and Utility Relocation
interventions.description: Widening the sidewalk to meet modern accessibility standards and relocating the utility pole to a furniture zone or behind the walkway.
